title: Entity pages for agencies, organizations/vendors, products, sources and sites
problem: Network nodes, task subjects and map points are UUIDs; no page describes an agency or vendor or lists what SIG knows about it (K12b NEW-1, NEW-16)
data_dependency: have: labels and per-predicate envelopes (support, currency, rationale) served by API /v1/entity; route: jurisdiction on agency entities (location null today); release export needs an entity table
risks: Part VIII: institutions only, never persons; officer-naming gate; handle-like source keys must never become titles (C2 NEW-2); HISTORICAL facts must show currency

title: Explain-this-number: numerator, denominator, rule, sources and rows behind every figure
problem: Home and dossier figures end at themselves; 124 tiles have no path (K12b NEW-14; C2 NEW-7)
data_dependency: have: coverage.json metrics, number_trace (C3), per-row source ids in exports
risks: Misleading impression if the census caveat is dropped; must show is_population_total=false

title: 'Find my place' resolver: city, county or address to dossier, map view and typed gaps
problem: Place names return 0 in search ('Texas', 'Houston', 'Canberra'); no city or county entry point (K12b NEW-10; C2 NEW-10)
data_dependency: have: jurisdictions, camera_county (25,802 subjects), site labels; needs a self-hosted gazetteer (static index)
risks: User privacy: an address or location must never be sent to a third-party geocoder (P16-like); must say when a place has no dossier and why

title: 'Who can access what': agency to configured partners and networks, partner degree, restrictions, dated; reverse view 'who can search agency X's data'
problem: The only sharing view is an undated UUID star; 185 partner-degree claims are hidden (K12b NEW-2, NEW-4)
data_dependency: have: 632 sharing rows (release); route: 474,184 Flock share-list edges in the ingested mirror need resolution (I3); jurisdiction on entities
risks: Historical sharing read as current; 'configured access' must never imply use; any ICE or federal link must be evidenced, never inferred; Flock portal rights (I3)

title: Date, source and currency on every relationship and figure
problem: 130 edges from 2020 records show no date or currency (K12b NEW-2)
data_dependency: have: observed_at, source_id and currency in the envelope
risks: Low; must also show when a value is undated ('not recorded')

title: One-page council brief: place name, known/unknown (typed), next decision date, 5 documents to bring, permalink and QR
problem: Print dossier is 5 pages of 'unknown' with no names (C2 NEW-6); no ranked documents
data_dependency: route: thin today (dossiers carry 1 count + source keys); improves as I-01/I-10 land
risks: A thin brief can read as 'nothing here'; neutral register (no advocacy); as-of + licence on every page

title: Decision calendar and subscriptions (iCal/RSS, email later) keyed on the decision date
problem: Watch empty; feeds 404; forward-dated fields never routed (K12b NEW-15)
data_dependency: route + acquire: response_deadline 987, renewal_options 195, sunset_date 5, bills 300, agenda tenants (I1); relevance unverified
js_dependency: none (static feeds); email needs a service
risks: Holding subscriber emails needs an operator decision and privacy posture; a missed date could cost a campaign — must say 'not tracked' loudly

title: What changed: per-release, per-source and per-place diff with RSS
problem: No changelog, release list or diff; API /v1/changes returns nothing (K12b NEW-19)
data_dependency: route: assertion timestamps in the spine; immutable releases (G3); /v1/changes to be fixed or explained
risks: Diff noise from connector re-runs read as real-world change; must separate 'SIG learned' from 'world changed' (bitemporal)

title: Source pages for every live source (about 218), including the about 40 non-registry sources
problem: Sources table lists 178 camera registries only; eff_data_driven and procurement/agenda sources untraceable (K12b NEW-12)
data_dependency: have: source registry, per-row rights_terms_url, freshness, evidence artifacts; route: per-run metrics (J3)
risks: Licence: downloads only where rights permit (J4); robots/opt-out status; mirrors labelled as mirrors (P15)

title: Dossier 'who contributed what, when' ledger (source x predicate x first/last seen)
problem: Dossier shows 3-4 source keys only; non-registry claims never reach the page (K12b NEW-3; C2 NEW-15)
data_dependency: have for site sources; route for non-registry claims (I1 NEW-4)
risks: Counting contributions can read as weight of evidence; show directness and support alongside

title: Contradiction browser: both sides, sources and dates, per place and entity
problem: 'Contradictions kept visible' but shown nowhere; 5,290 conflicted subjects are dead links (K12b NEW-7, NEW-17)
data_dependency: have: 2 recorded contradictions (API) + 5,290 conflicted subjects (release)
risks: Must not pick a winner; neutral wording; hostile-reader review (SIG-UI-042)

title: 'What we don't know' gap view per place: typed absence per predicate and technology class, linked to tasks
problem: Absence is one line per dossier; absence kinds can be wrong (K12b NEW-3)
data_dependency: have: gaps, coverage metrics, I1 class coverage table
risks: Must compute absence against all claims about entities in the place, or it misreports (NEW-3)

title: Research tasks as human questions plus records-request templates
problem: Queue cards are UUIDs; the first 130 are really 'is agency X still sharing with Vigilant LEARN?' (K12b NEW-16)
data_dependency: have: task rows, entity labels, last-evidence dates; templates (SIG-TASK-015/016)
risks: No legal advice; no public write path until the ADR-068 posture changes; never claim a task was filed on a GET (C2 NEW-22)

title: Guided 'start here' journeys per persona on the home page
problem: Home is 124 tautological tiles; no route to the three co-primary tasks (C2 NEW-17)
data_dependency: n/a
risks: Journeys that dead-end on thin data erode trust; each must end on an honest state

title: Cross-jurisdiction comparison (2-5 places) with CSV
problem: Comparing TX, CA and NY means opening three identical templates (K12b section 3.3)
data_dependency: have: jurisdictions.csv, coverage, dossiers.json
risks: Coverage differences read as density differences (SIG-UI-018); ID/CA/CO code collisions must be fixed first

title: Map feature pages and cite-a-point
problem: Popups are dead ends; 'Cite this view' cites the national map (K12b NEW-6)
data_dependency: have: sites exports (label, source, precision, upstream URL)
risks: Tier/precision rules (SIG-PUB-004): no page may publish a point above its tier; mobile assets never at current position

title: Map filters, legend and real layer toggles (technology, source, operator, licence, date), clustering
problem: Only zoom and attribution controls; 'Layers' are labels (C2 NEW-23; K12b NEW-9)
data_dependency: partial: technology fields sparse (camera_type 550, asset_type 651); source and compartment complete
risks: Filtering by operator needs resolved operators; must keep the coverage underlay bound (SIG-UI-017)

title: Typed graph atlases: procurement (buyer to seller), funding (funder to recipient), sharing
problem: The only graph is one 130-spoke star (K12b NEW-5)
data_dependency: route: buyer 6,796, seller 2,788, funder 1,279, recipient 2,158 need entity resolution
risks: Unresolved names produce false merges; ER quality disclosure on every statistic (SIG-UI-023)

title: Keyboard-first graph navigation with a list/table twin (arrow-key neighbours, type-ahead, breadcrumbs)
problem: 160 Tab stops to cross /network/; map features not operable (K12b NEW-5, NEW-9)
data_dependency: n/a
risks: Must stay equivalent to the no-JS lists (SIG-UI-050)

title: Embeddable static figure cards for journalists (SVG/HTML, no iframe JS) with as-of, source, caveat and permalink
problem: No share or embed path; C2 NEW-27 (no social metadata)
data_dependency: have
risks: Figures lifted out of context; caveat and licence must travel in the card; egress cost of hotlinking (SIG-EXPORT-008)

title: Citation tools: formats (APA, Chicago, legal), per-figure anchors, release-pinned URLs
problem: Permalinks do not pin (C2 NEW-4); citations name only the page
data_dependency: depends on C2 NEW-4 fix and release identity (G3)
risks: A citation that does not pin is worse than none

title: Data-quality badges on figures, sources and edges (support, currency, directness, coverage, human-reviewed)
problem: Support glyph alone; currency and review state hidden (K12b NEW-2)
data_dependency: have
risks: Badges can be read as endorsement; must be neutral and explained

title: Download this view: CSV/JSON of exactly the rows shown, with licence header
problem: No page offers a download (C2 NEW-8)
data_dependency: have
risks: Share-alike and operator-accepted compartments cannot be merged (J4, SIG-EXPORT-005); egress

title: Peer link-outs with agreement markers (Atlas, DeFlock/OSM, Eyes on Flock, MuckRock) per place and agency
problem: No outbound links anywhere (K12b NEW-21)
data_dependency: have: these sources are ingested
risks: Mirrors counted as independent (P15 lineage); crowdsourced maps under Part VIII review

title: Typed knowledge-graph search: names, places, aliases, exact tokens, facets
problem: Substring search over 733 items; false hits on 'ICE'; names SIG holds return 0 (K12b NEW-10)
data_dependency: have: API /v1/search already returns typed named entities; release FTS5 index (P32.14) at chain tip
risks: Zero-result copy must stay 'not evidence of absence'; sensitive queries need exact matching

title: Evidence locker: all captured artifacts with type, source, capture date, hash, supported claims, original URL
problem: Evidence page empty though 255 artifacts exist (K12b NEW-13)
data_dependency: have: evidence.json (255); route: human titles for artifacts
risks: Redistribution rights of captures (J4); sealed captures metadata-only (SIG-UI-030)

title: 'Ask this graph' canonical-question pages per place (who supplies, who can search, what was approved, when it renews)
problem: Open-ended questions have partial answers in the data but no page (K12b section 4)
data_dependency: route: depends on I-01, I-04, I-07
risks: Implies completeness; each answer must carry typed unknowns and coverage

title: Entity and place timelines (contracts, bills, portal updates, lifecycle transitions)
problem: Dossier 'Timeline' section is an empty heading (C2 NEW-5)
data_dependency: route: award_date 1,051, bill_status_date 300, portal_last_updated_declared 1,528, lifecycle_transition 6,661
risks: World time and belief time must not be conflated

title: Flock transparency-portal policy view per agency (stated retention, prohibited uses, aggregate search and hotlist counts, dated)
problem: 1,528 portals' stated policies are invisible (K12b NEW-14)
data_dependency: have (via community mirror); rights of the mirror unresolved (I1, I3)
risks: Part VIII: aggregates only — never per-search rows, officer names or search reasons; mirror rights

title: Coverage-honesty place card: sources and technology classes SIG has looked at, and which are missing
problem: A dossier's thinness is unexplained
data_dependency: have: I1 per-state class coverage
risks: Must not read as a completeness score

title: Funding trail: grants to agency to technology
problem: USAspending/FEMA grant claims never reach a page
data_dependency: route: funder 1,279, recipient 2,158, federal_award_id 1,958 need entity resolution
risks: Grant purpose may not be surveillance-specific; show matched keywords and directness

title: 'Near me' local list without the 3.4 MB map page (static shards; optional browser geolocation that never leaves the device)
problem: Mobile map fails; list requires the heavy page (C2 NEW-32)
data_dependency: have: sites + H3 bins
risks: User location must stay client-side; precision tiers respected
